summary: testRealHealthResultsPreserveAttentionThenClearAfterHealthyStateResponse drives PiHealthChecker.check against a real fake-pi subprocess RPC exchange (not a mock), first observing an attention response set piHealthIssue, then a genuine successful get_state response with no attention event clears it to nil; sibling tests confirm failure/timeout/exit paths never produce .healthy, so AppModel's unconditional clear-on-.healthy branch cannot spuriously fire on those inputs.
